mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder_dispatch_attempt (node_codes,scheduled_at,status,attempts,started_at) VALUES (#{nodeCodes},#{scheduledAt},'RUNNING',1,#{startedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='RUNNING', attempts=attempts+1, started_at=VALUES(started_at), finished_at=NULL, error_msg=NULL, next_retry_at=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE reminder_dispatch_attempt SET status='SUCCESS', todos=#{todos}, pushes=#{pushes}, unresolved_count=#{unresolvedCount}, error_msg=NULL, next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, finished_at=#{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE scheduled_at=#{scheduledAt} AND node_codes=#{nodeCodes}

UPDATE reminder_dispatch_attempt SET status=#{status}, error_msg=#{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, finished_at=#{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE scheduled_at=#{scheduledAt} AND node_codes=#{nodeCodes}
